Token Bound Account (TBA) logic contract for SpooVault NFTs.      Each SpooVault Access Token (SPVT) NFT deployed through {SpooVault} can      be bound to its own smart-contract wallet via {ERC6551Registry}.  This      contract acts as the *implementation* that every minimal ERC-1167 proxy      delegates to.      Context resolution      \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500      The bound NFT triple (chainId, tokenContract, tokenId) is stored in the      registry at deployment time and retrieved via `accountContext(address(this))`.      The registry address is passed once at construction and stored in an      immutable so it is baked into every proxy's delegatecall targets.      Capabilities      \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500      \u2022 executeCall  \u2014 the NFT owner forwards arbitrary contract calls from        the TBA address (e.g. approve document access, transfer sub-tokens).      \u2022 Receive ETH & tokens \u2014 the TBA natively holds ETH, ERC-721, ERC-1155.      \u2022 state()  \u2014 monotonically-increasing nonce; increments per execution.      \u2022 token()  \u2014 returns (chainId, tokenContract, tokenId) of the bound NFT.      \u2022 owner()  \u2014 live ERC-721 owner query; updates instantly on transfer.      Security model      \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500      Only the current ERC-721 owner of the bound NFT may call `executeCall`. params._registry: Address of the {ERC6551Registry} that stores TBA context.

executeCall(address,uint256,bytes).details: Only the current owner of the bound NFT may call this function.      The `state` nonce is incremented on every successful execution so      clients can detect replays after NFT transfer.

returns.result: The raw bytes returned by the callee.

owner().details: Queries `ownerOf` on the ERC-721 token contract live so ownership      changes are reflected immediately without any local state update.

returns._0: The address that owns the bound NFT.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Reports support for ERC-165, ERC-721 token-receiver, and      ERC-1155 token-receiver interfaces.

token().details: Calls `accountContext(address(this))` on the {ERC6551Registry} to      retrieve the (chainId, tokenContract, tokenId) stored at deployment.      When executed via delegatecall from the proxy, `address(this)` resolves      to the proxy address, giving the correct per-NFT context.

returns.chainId: Chain ID the NFT belongs to.

executeCall(address,uint256,bytes).notice: Executes an arbitrary call from the TBA address.

owner().notice: Returns the current owner of the bound NFT.

registry().notice: The ERC6551Registry that deployed (and tracks context for) this TBA.

token().notice: Returns the bound NFT's identifying triple.
